meta.title: 销售难题：怎么证明你们是专家
meta.title_en: The Sales Challenge: How Do You Prove You're Experts

scenes.title_cn: 大难题与 GE 的答案
scenes.title_en: The hard question and GE's answer
scenes.context: 讲者抛出卖销售必被客户挑战的难题：怎么证明你们是专家？在通用电气时客户从不问，因为名片上的 GE logo 已经提前告诉对方了。
sentences: 怎么证明你们是专家？这是销售必被挑战的大难题。
How do you prove you're experts? It's the question every salesperson gets challenged on.
大难题：the big challenge
通用电气时期，电力系统的客户从来不会问我这个问题。
At GE, power-system clients never asked me this question.
电力系统客户：power-system clients
名片上 GE 的 logo，已经提前告诉对方了。
The GE logo on my card had already told them.
提前告诉：already told them
paraphrase: 证明专家 → 客户终极拷问
Proving expertise is the customer's ultimate test.
A big brand's logo speaks before you do.
scenes.speak: How do you prove you're experts? It's the question every salesperson gets challenged on. At GE, power-system clients never asked me this question. The GE logo on my card had already told them.

scenes.context: 讲者转到创业公司后问题来了：电力局客户说选 ABB、西门子、GE，将来出问题选择也是正确的；选你们即使选对了也可能被说选错。大品牌销售提成低，创业公司提成高但难题大。
sentences: 选 ABB、西门子、GE，将来出问题我的选择也是正确的。
Choosing ABB, Siemens, or GE is a correct choice even if problems arise later.
出问题：problems arise
选你们，即使选对了，将来也可能被说选错了。
Choosing you, even when right, could later be judged wrong.
被说选错：be judged wrong
在知名企业做销售提成低，信任来自品牌 logo，跟你没关系。
At big firms commissions are low — trust comes from the logo, not from you.
提成：commission
paraphrase: Choosing big brands is always the safe call.
选新公司 → 风险自负
Picking a startup means owning the risk.
scenes.speak: Choosing ABB, Siemens, or GE is a correct choice even if problems arise later. Choosing you, even when right, could later be judged wrong. At big firms commissions are low — trust comes from the logo, not from you.

scenes.context: 讲者转做培训后找到答案：给你一张 A4 纸，不停写出这个领域 50 个关键词，不能停、不能重复——真专家脱口而出，半瓶醋当场冒冷汗。
sentences: 给你一张 A4 纸，请不停顿地写出这个领域的 50 个关键词。
Take an A4 sheet and write 50 keywords in your field without pausing.
不停顿：without pausing
要求有两个：第一不能停，第二不能重复。
Two rules: no pausing, and no repeating.
不能重复：no repeating
半瓶醋已经开始冒冷汗了，因为他写不出来。
The half-baked expert starts sweating because he can't write them.
半瓶醋：half-baked expert
paraphrase: A4纸写50词 → 真专家脱口而出
Fifty keywords on the spot separate the real from the fake.
不能停不能重复 → 检验功底
No pause, no repeat — a true test of depth.
scenes.speak: Take an A4 sheet and write 50 keywords in your field without pausing. Two rules: no pausing, and no repeating. The half-baked expert starts sweating because he can't write them.

practice: Every salesperson gets challenged on proof of expertise.
The logo had already vouched for us.
The half-baked expert couldn't write them.
Two rules: no pausing and no repeating.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：How to prove you are expert?
✓ 地道说法：How do you prove you're experts?
英文疑问句要用 do you 结构。
✕ 直译腔：The client never asked me this.
✓ 地道说法：The client never asked me this question.
口语中补上 question 更完整。
✕ 直译腔：Commission money is very low.
✕ 直译腔：Half bottle vinegar is sweating.
✓ 地道说法：The half-baked expert starts sweating.
半瓶醋要意译为 half-baked expert。
shifts: 把信任寄托在品牌 logo 上
把信任建立在可验证的能力上
用可测试的动作证明专业度
看清信任来源与个人价值的关系
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词（GE、ABB、西门子、A4 纸）已保留并校正。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
